youtubeTitle: Orders, Escrow, and Safe Handoffs in Aquacellum
youtubeDescription: Learn how Aquacellum ensures safe buying and selling for aquarists. From escrow-protected payments to verified in-person pickups, we cover tools that keep transactions smooth and secure. Perfect for breeders and buyers alike.

beats.onScreen: Aquacellum logo animation, followed by the Orders dashboard.
beats.narration: Aquacellum helps aquarists buy and sell fish with confidence. Today, we’ll explore orders, escrow protection, and safe handoffs.

beats.onScreen: Highlight the Order filters: All, Active, Completed, and Disputed.
beats.narration: Your Orders dashboard keeps everything organized. Filter by status to see active, completed, or disputed transactions.

beats.onScreen: Show Checkout lanes: Stripe escrow, in-person pickup, batch/fry.
beats.narration: Checkout offers options tailored to your needs. Choose Stripe escrow for shipped orders, or coordinate in-person pickups. Batch orders are ideal for fry or large groups.

beats.onScreen: Visualize escrow protection: funds held, 3-day window, disputes, DOA claims.
beats.narration: Escrow keeps your payment secure. Funds are held until arrival, with a three-day safety window for disputes or dead-on-arrival claims.

beats.onScreen: Show map/address and propose-a-time tools for pickups.
beats.narration: For in-person pickups, coordinate easily. Share a pickup location, propose times, and confirm your arrival.
Verified handoffs use a PIN or QR code. Both parties confirm the exchange, ensuring a secure transfer.

beats.onScreen: Highlight buyer insights and XP progress (blur gated areas).
beats.narration: Track your progress with buyer insights and XP. Analytics and reorder tools unlock as you gain experience.

beats.onScreen: Show Incoming/Transit dashboard with tracking numbers.
beats.narration: When items ship, the Incoming dashboard keeps track. View tracking numbers and prepare for their arrival.

beats.onScreen: Demonstrate Acclimation checklist and Confirm Arrival flow.
beats.narration: Use the acclimation checklist to guide new arrivals safely into their tanks. Confirm arrival to assign them and complete the process.

beats.onScreen: Close with a buyer leaving a review from the receipt screen.
beats.narration: Once your order is complete, leave a review. Feedback helps breeders improve and builds trust in the community.
Aquacellum makes buying and selling fish safer and simpler. Explore your Orders today.
